recommendation: treat every incoming key string as untrusted until it passes full validation
why_it_matters: corrupted keys should not be allowed to influence navigation or derived results

recommendation: do not expose parent ancestor descendant or kind helpers on partially validated data
why_it_matters: partial success can leak inconsistent state into higher-level logic

recommendation: reject odd token counts empty segments and depth overflows before any deeper traversal
why_it_matters: cheap structural guards prevent malformed inputs from triggering unnecessary work

recommendation: prefer iterative loops with explicit segment counters over open-ended recursion on key input
why_it_matters: bounded traversal prevents stack growth and non-terminating behavior on corrupted inputs

recommendation: validate schema integrity before accepting it for key parsing or traversal
why_it_matters: broken schema graphs can otherwise create incorrect results or infinite traversal risks

recommendation: reject schema cycles and keep traversal helpers working only on validated acyclic schema state
why_it_matters: ancestor and descendant logic must never depend on graph shapes that can loop forever

recommendation: reject terminal nodes that still declare children and fail closed on impossible parent child transitions
why_it_matters: inconsistent schema edges should not be silently tolerated

recommendation: when a key fails validation return failure and do not try to salvage derived fields or canonical strings
why_it_matters: fail-closed behavior avoids corrupted results that look valid enough to reuse

recommendation: only serialize from validated parsed data and always emit canonical label:value pairs
why_it_matters: this prevents ambiguous or attacker-shaped strings from being reintroduced downstream

recommendation: do not cache unvalidated parse results and keep validation or prefix caches scoped and bounded
why_it_matters: untrusted inputs should not be able to grow caches without limit

recommendation: default batch validation to stop-first and only enable collect-invalids intentionally for debugging
why_it_matters: large hostile batches should be cheap to reject

recommendation: when scanning candidate keys for children compare bounded validated segment arrays and enforce maxDepth filters
why_it_matters: relationship queries should not depend on reparsing or unchecked prefix math
